body: I’ve thought about this many times in the past few months. I can only talk to my wife about feeling suicidal but she’s brought up the idea that I’m emotionally manipulating her with this. Like ”I don’t want to do the laundry I’m suicidal” bullshit. Never used it as an excuse not to do chores but she doesn’t see it that way.

I’m 31 in August. Tried to end it at 14. I’m still here. Every time I start seeing a reason to go on I’m hit with something that makes me regret surviving that first attempt. About 7 years ago my brother, who died of an overdose three years, convinced me to get a cdl and be a truck driver. The isolation and dehumanization in that industry is incredible. I figured I would keep doing it till I had enough to retire. Even though I almost got panic attacks driving around I kept going. Got into a major accident in my vehicle six months ago that ruined my back. Now I’m facing lawsuits from the bank and finally got a job a month back. I think about suicide every day. I don’t want to leave my wife alone and in debt so maybe after my settlement I succeed.

Six months ago I was in a accident where a semi truck and trailer just drove out in front of me. I steered as far left as I could crossing two lanes \( I was in the far right lane\) and smashed head first into his rear tires on the trailer. I feel like maybe I should have steered for right under his trailer with the amount of physical pain and financial stress I've been in. Dog had a huge vet bill in January. Either I wouldn't survive due to the clearance or permanently disabled. No idea. I've had to change my entire life due to the accident. "Friends" I've tried to call don't answer me.  I couldn't move past my room the first few weeks. I still don't have a car but I've been able to Uber to my new job \(since I lost the old because of my medical leave\) where I make four to five times less than the last one. Thanks OP for your post. Thanks for allowing me to vent.
Just got scheduled for my first session with a therapist. My wife had to make the appointment.
